The relief sought in the present writ petitions is to direct the first respondent to disburse the interest under Section 24 of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001.
2. It is not in dispute that the land belonging to the petitioners was acquired.
The petitioners received compensation determined by the Land Acquisition Officer.
An application was submitted claiming interest for the period from the date of actual possession till the date of passing of the award.

sentences.text: Section 24 of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act, 2001, stipulates that when the amount is not paid or deposited on or before taking possession of the land, the Government shall pay the amount determined with interest thereon, at the rate of 9% per annum, from the time of so taking possession until it shall have been so paid or deposited.
4. In view of the Section 24, the petitioners are entitled to claim interest for the belated deposit or payment of compensation.

Accordingly, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No.5469 & 7843 of 2023 the respondents are directed to calculate the interest as admissible under Section 24 of the Tamil Nadu Highways Act 2001 and settle the same in favour of the petitioners within a period of eight (8) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, the writ petitions stand allowed.
No costs.
